title: GOV-0017: G01 has a lifecycle contract but no evidence semantics
problem:
## Observed (measured on `main` 2c5cb71)
`badf/lifecycle.json` G01 requires evidence `prd`, `acceptance-criteria`, `product-approval` (owner `product_owner`, floor C1), and `validate_evidence` checks every evidence record the same way: schema fields, outcome PASS, producer present, toolchain present, artifact digest. It never opens the artifact. A `prd` whose artifact is one line of text, an `acceptance-criteria` artifact with no criteria, and a `product-approval` produced by the PRD's own author all render APPROVED today. With `advance` (WP-0029) an instance can now reach `G01 / APPROVED` on that.

## Expected (WP-B of the plan on #41, BADF-DEC-0007)
Per-type evidence rules **inside `validate_evidence`** — no second validator:
- `prd`: artifact is JSON conforming to `schemas/prd.schema.json`; no item in both `in_scope` and `out_of_scope`; every objective's `metric_refs` resolves to a declared success metric; no unresolved placeholders.
- `acceptance-criteria`: JSON conforming to its schema; non-empty; unique ids; no placeholders.
- `product-approval`: produced by a **human** `product_owner` whose principal ≠ the PRD's author; bound by digest to the exact `prd` artifact bytes it approves (a PRD edited after approval invalidates the approval).
- An `examples/gate-dossier.G01.json` that validates, and CI validating it like G00's.

Salvage from PR #44 (closed, branch `feature/BADF-WP-G01-001-gate-01-prd-baseline` @ `e3cfde1`): its schema, template, the semantic tests, and the `badf-prd` skill doc — copy minimal + test. No `scripts/badf_prd.py`.

## Unknowns
Whether `product_owner` must also appear among the dossier's approvals at C1 (matrix roles are engineering_owner + independent_reviewer). Reading: the human product-approval **evidence** is the product owner's act; the dossier approvals stay the matrix's. Stated in the doc.

## Proposed work package
`BADF-WP-0030`. Class C2 (contract impact). Tests failing-first; mutation per rule; compose both shapes.

status: PROPOSED (WP-B of the #41 plan; authority: the operator's "proceed on your call", 2026-08-28)
